name: com.pnscripts.whumpkit-lite
displayName: Whumpkit Lite: Camera Shake and Hit-Stop
description: Free game feel for Unity: trauma camera shake that leaves your camera controller in charge, and hit-stop that restores your time scale. Plain C# core with tests. By PN Scripts, MIT licence.

samples.description: Builds a camera and a cube at runtime and hits on a timer: shake and hit-stop. Add the component to an empty GameObject in an empty scene and press Play.
